html:
SMTO-WEB-0020 — The answer pointed to a source SMTO never read

GUID: 2b983635-4ec5-5438-b8c5-9fcd9956a442
Slug: research-unknown-source-reference
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • The answer named or linked a source that SMTO has no record of reading, so it can't be shown as proof. The pages SMTO did read are still saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait for the run to finish. SMTO sends the answer back to the Model to remove or fix the unread source. The check usually only needs the Model to cite pages that are in SMTO's research record.
  2. If you want a specific page used, send its full web address and ask SMTO to read that page. Once SMTO reads a page, it becomes a recorded source that the answer can cite.
  3. If the run stops and an unchecked answer is acceptable to you, open the Research proof validation card shown in the run and turn off Enforce this check for this run. This lets the answer through, but its links may point to pages SMTO never checked.

What success looks like

  • The answer appears and every link in it points to a page SMTO read during this run.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't treat links that SMTO never read as verified sources.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Research proof rejected the completion because an evidence span references a source ID absent from the research record, or uncovered answer text contains a URL outside the structured claim map.

What this means

  • Proof encounters an absent source behind an evidence span or a URL left outside the structured claim coverage. This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.

Why this can happen

  • Proof encounters an absent source behind an evidence span or a URL left outside the structured claim coverage.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the source ID, span linkage and any uncovered URL in the proposed answer.

How to fix it

  • Raised as research_unknown_source_reference by _verify_fact (span.source_id not in research.sources) or _validate_answer (uncovered text contains http(s) URLs). The completion must cite only sources in the research record via claim references; remove bare URLs from answer prose or obtain the page through Web Read so it becomes a recorded source.
  • Use retained source references and remove or qualify URLs that lack supported evidence.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use verified facts or an explicit scoped limitation.

How to verify the fix

  • Each published source resolves through a retained eligible observation.

What not to do

  • Do not invent a source reference or use an unobserved URL as supporting evidence.

Technical notes

  • This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
